richiami.difetto: A bolt with a reduced shank diameter could cause the torque pin to slide out of the rear lower suspension arm. This may lead to overload and failure of the lower suspension arm, which can cause damage to other suspension components and the rear brakes, which could cause an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

traduzione.difetto: Un bullone con diametro ridotto del gambo potrebbe causare lo scivolamento della punta di coppia dall'arto inferiore posteriore sospensione. Ciò potrebbe portare a un sovraccarico e al guasto dell'arto sospensivo inferiore, che potrebbe causare danni ad altri componenti sospensione e ai freni posteriori, che potrebbero causare un incidente. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, e dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: Excessively long bolts on the fusebox locking plate may damage the wiring harness. This may cause the vehicle’s power supply, lights, power-assisted steering and other systems to fail. Moreover, the fusebox could overheat and catch fire. The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

traduzione.difetto: Buloni eccessivamente lunghi sulla placca di blocco della scatola dei fusibili possono danneggiare lo schermo elettrico. Ciò potrebbe causare il malfunzionamento dell’alimentazione elettrica del veicolo, dei fari, del sistema di sterzo assistito e di altri sistemi. Inoltre, la scatola dei fusibili potrebbe surriscaldarsi e incendiarsi. Il prodotto non risponde ai requisiti stabiliti dal Regolamento sull’approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: Variable pressure control during the extrusion process can cause irregularities, cracks or kinks in the internal wall of oil cooler hoses. This increases the risk of an accident or fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.

I tubi dei radiatori di olio possono esplodere, potenzialmente causando il blocco o il surriscaldamento del motore. Ciò aumenta il rischio di incidenti o incendi. richiami.difetto: The fixings for the fuse box cables can be incorrectly torqued, causing the cables to become loose. This can lead to an electrical power loss in the vehicle or cause heat damage to the fuse box. Loss of electrical power can result in the engine stalling or loss of headlights, power assisted steering or other vehicle functions. This can increase the risk of accidents and injuries. Heat damage to the fuse box can cause smoke in the trunk, increasing the risk of fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

traduzione.difetto: I fissaggi dei cavi della scatola dei fusibili possono essere torquati in modo errato, causando che i cavi si allentino. Ciò può provocare una perdita di potenza elettrica nel veicolo o danni termici alla scatola dei fusibili. La perdita di potenza elettrica può causare il blocco del motore o la perdita dei fari, del sistema di sterzo assistito o di altre funzioni del veicolo. Ciò può aumentare il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. I danni termici alla scatola dei fusibili possono causare fumo nel bagagliaio, aumentando il rischio di incendio. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: As part of a software update the stored adjustment settings for the automatic clutch were not deleted and re-taught. These stored settings are incompatible with the updated software and can result in incorrect operation in certain circumstances. This may adversely affect gear changes including uncommanded selection of neutral. If neutral is selected manual gear selection will be available.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles the clutch software will be re-installed and the system re-taught.
richiami.titolo: TRANSMISSION CAN CHANGE GEAR WITHOUT CONTROL FROM DRIVER

richiami.difetto: null When the front, right seat is operated to rearward position, the seat runner can compress the battery supply cable. If the cable is repeatedly compressed, the insulation of the electrical cable can be damaged and a short-circuit can occur between the cable and the runner, resulting in smoke in the vehicle cabin. The smoke could cause the driver to be distracted and increase the risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: null The printed circuit boards in the transmission control switches may be defective.  If affected, the vehicle will lose power and the transmission will default to neutral gear.  This may increase the risk of a vehicle crash.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: DB9 (Coupe and Volante) and Rapide S produced between 10/6/13 and 30/6/14
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: null The printed circuit boards in the transmission control switches may be defective.

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the transmission switches have a chrome plating surround. This can interact with the printed circuit board within the switches and create an intermittent earth path to other surrounding parts In the subject vehicles this can cause the transmission to default to neutral without any driver input for gear selection resulting in a loss drive.
richiami.rimedio: Replace existing switches with updated version. Brakes and steering are not affected.
richiami.titolo: INTERMITTENT FAULT WITH TRANSMISSION CONTROL SWITCHES

richiami.difetto: The throttle pedal may fail resulting in the driver being unable to accelerate or maintain speed. The throttle pedal arm on the affected vehicles is not to specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the throttle pedal with one of the correct specification.
richiami.titolo: THROTTLE PEDAL MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: It has been established that the Tyre Pressure Management System (TPMS) ECU had been installed with incorrect specification software for the front axle. The software allows for a greater tyre pressure difference between tyres on the front axle. If this occurs it could in extreme circumstances affect the stability and directional control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles and install the correct software.
richiami.titolo: DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It has been established that the front suspension bottom suspension arm cam-bolt may be out of specification.  It is possible that these bolts could crack and fail.  This could in extreme cases affect the directional control of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the cam-bolt.
richiami.titolo: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles for the replacement of the cam-bolt.
richiami.titolo: STEERING MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that during the build process of the subject vehicles a safety critical action to check the torque of the front sub frame assembly bolts was omitted. Should the situation be ignored the driver would become aware of an unusual steering response.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject bolts inspected to ascertain whether they have been paint marked to indicate that the torque has been checked during production. Should this not be the case the bolts will be re-torqued.
richiami.titolo: STEERING RESPONSE MAY BE INCORRECT

richiami.difetto: The engine may not start because the power train to chassis primary earth stud may have intermittent high resistance. This condition may occur when electrical items that draw high current are utilised  in which case the electrical path could route through the rear braided hoses causing them to heat up and possibly melt  leading to a soft pedalillumination of the brake warning lamp and poor starting.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected so the primary earth stud can be moved to a new location and fit a secondary earth strap between the transmission and chassis.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY NOT START

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles may have been manufactured with an automatic transmission parking brake component which may not have been hardened to the correct specification. This could result in the transmission parking brake not engaging when park on the transmission is selected.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the parking brake pawl guide plate replaced with a quality assured item.
richiami.titolo: AUTOMATIC  TRANSMISSION PARKING BRAKE MAY NOT ENGAGE

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a number of vehicles have been assembled with two in-line rear brake pressure reducing valves installed to one of the rear brake lines instead of one valve in each rear brake line. This condition can cause the vehicle to pull slightly to one side under heavy braking efficiency however is maintained as the system is regulated by the ABS.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and modify to one brake pressure reducing valve to each rear brake line.
richiami.titolo: REAR BRAKE PRESSURE REDUCING VALVES CONNECTED INCORRECTLY

richiami.difetto: The electronic throttle pedal assembly cross shaft can become displaced from its housing following involuntary displacement of an ultrasonically domed head (LHS end).  This is designed to keep the cross shaft in place along with a secondary retaining cross pin at the opposite side of the housing. With the cross shaft displaced throttle control is lost.  If ignored a failed cross shaft would lead to loss of throttle control whilst driving.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicles will be recalled at which time the throttle assembly will be checked for compliance with specification. Should a non-compliance be identified the throttle pedal assembly will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THROTTLE CONTROL MAY BE LOST

richiami.difetto: Power assisted steering high pressure flexible hose may contact the left hand exhaust manifold and burn through leading to a progressive loss of hydraulic fluid and power assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Check the position of the high pressure hose in relation to the exhaust manifold. If the hose is touching the manifold or there is insufficient air gap fit a new high pressure hose and reposition and clip as specified.
richiami.titolo: POWER ASSISTED STEERING HOSE MAY CONTACT THE LEFT HAND EXHAUST MANIFOLD AND BURN THROUGH

richiami.difetto: The steering column lighting switchgear wires can potentially become trapped leading to partial loss of lighting functionality during operation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a quality assured steering column switchgear assembly
richiami.titolo: LIGHTING EQUIPMENT SWITCHGEAR CONCERN.
